description: This file defines data structures and classes for managing resource grid allocations in a 5G NR scheduler, including grant info, carrier resource grids, and slot resource management, with functions for collision detection and resource usage tracking.

classes.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid
classes.description: Represents the symbol x CRB resource grid for a carrier, managing allocations and collision detection.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_grid
classes.description: Manages RB and symbol allocations across multiple carriers within a cell for a specific slot.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator
classes.description: Stores scheduling info and resource allocations for a specific cell and slot.

classes.name: cell_resource_allocator
classes.description: Circular buffer managing resource allocations over multiple slots, with history for error handling.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Allocates specified resources in the grid.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deallocates specified resources in the grid.

methods.name: collides
methods.description: Checks for resource collisions in the grid.

methods.name: all_set
methods.description: Checks if all specified resources are allocated.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the current slot in the resource allocator.
